name: Aletsch panorama trail
why: Along the ridge above the Great Aletsch Glacier, the longest of the Alps, from Moosfluh to Bettmerhorn, a river of ice 20 km long at your feet.
book: Lifts from Riederalp and Bettmeralp (car-free villages, cable car from the Rhône valley).
dangers: Afternoon thunderstorms in summer: be off the high paths by 14:00.

points.name: Moosfluh
points.note: The lift above Riederalp at the glacier's edge.

points.name: Bettmerhorn
points.note: A rocky top with the glacier stretching north.
